reply_text:
I found three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and sent Pree the list in her DM (DSHARED0001):

- **#4409:** The Gatehouse Check-In report keeps timing out at the Salina North yard. This is from Moss's "Central handoffs next week" digest, dated 2 Jan 2026.
- **#4412:** A glitch in the driver SMS prompt when combine trailers are staged on unpaved overflow lots. This is from the same Moss digest.
- **PD-5302:** A follow-up from this week. Hollis posted it in #central-random on 14 Oct.

**Possible fourth ticket:** #8841, which Tobias raised in #central-random on 13 Oct, may also be Fieldworks. His message only says "Tobias's dealer account," so I left it off the list and told Pree why.

**Not Fieldworks:** FR-882 and PD-4821 are Marrow Agrisupply tickets, and #88412 is Tansleigh Packaging. I listed these separately so they don't get mixed in.

**Where I looked:**
- **Moss's notes:** I found only two shared Central digests from Moss, and the cheat sheet has no ticket numbers. Pree may not be able to see any personal notes Moss keeps, and I told her I couldn't find any.
- **This week's chat:** I read every channel Pree belongs to: #central-random, #central-team, #general, #help-it-ops and #inc-tansley-carrier-api. Only the two #central-random messages above mention tickets. I didn't open channels she isn't in or use the cross-workspace message search.
- **gbrain:** The search was refused because its access token isn't linked to any member. To fix that, someone with admin access on the gbrain server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`.
